items: Each island now has a challenge area at the end of the footpaths: a wide stone circle with the island's glowing sigil and a ring of columns, the forest close around it, guarded by an adult and a youth of every animal on the island

Win every one of them over (or see them off), then hold E in the middle of the circle to cast the music spell: a dancefloor like the one at home fills the circle, lit on the beat, the animals dance on it, and the columns fire fireworks one after another round the ring, a bar at a time
Tonight's find then comes down from the sky onto the dancefloor for you to pick up; once you've found everything, a flask comes down instead
Challenges are optional and stay open until the night is won or lost
